requirements.requirement: Connect lan-a and lan-b with routed WireGuard interface wg01 on node1 and node2.
requirements.summary: Both gateways show post-restart wg01 interfaces, reciprocal peers and allowed networks, current handshakes, transfer counters, and remote-LAN routes through wg01. A source-bound request traverses the configured LAN gateways successfully.

requirements.requirement: Keep routed cross-LAN traffic free of address translation.
requirements.summary: Final gateway configuration shows no NAT on either VyOS system, while node3 records the original node4 LAN address, 192.168.20.10, for successful requests to 192.168.10.10.

requirements.requirement: Serve the lan-a application from node3 on TCP port 8080 and allow node4 to reach it through the tunnel.
requirements.summary: After every node restart, node3's enabled service is active and listening only on 192.168.10.10:8080; node4 receives HTTP 200 using its lan-b source address, and node3 logs that request.

requirements.requirement: Limit new cross-LAN connections to the node4-to-node3 TCP/8080 application path.
requirements.summary: Both gateways retain default-drop forwarding with one exact new-connection permit for 192.168.20.10 to 192.168.10.10 TCP/8080. A locally reachable TCP/8081 listener times out from node4 and increments node2's drop counter; reverse cross-LAN ICMP fails and increments node1's drop counter. The test listener was removed.

overall_summary: All four material task outcomes are satisfied and remained functional after the required restart sequence. The restart evidence protocol is complete and consistent with the fixed lifecycle observations. The only hygiene defect was a brief, corrected node1 forwarding over-permit during configuration; it did not persist or affect final functionality.
limitations: The node1 pre-restart aggregate probe used invalid combined WireGuard field syntax, making that sub-output unusable (cmd-2d7f7196b89e496d). Separate same-boot evidence directly showed active forwarding, transfer counters, no NAT, and successful HTTP before the restart (cmd-d0553a62d84144a9, cmd-0d34126b7fb84464, cmd-b5ca58801c954f74), so this leaves no material restart-evidence gap.

operational_hygiene.summary: One unnecessary transient mutation occurred: cmd-9a96563d871d48ee committed node1 rule 5 as an unconditional forwarding accept because its state setters failed while the script continued. Cmd-d6136d4ad5c34ca3 immediately constrained it to established/related before node2 and the LAN hosts were configured, so the weakening did not remain. The TCP/8081 listeners were bounded evidence probes and were cleaned up. No failed services, package damage, or test listener residue remained. Separately, the mandatory restart protocol was complete on all four nodes: each had a healthy pre-state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered networking, service, data where applicable, and end-to-end behavior; lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate every transition.
